# Community Rule Column 9 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1** They shall not depart from any counsel of the Torah to walk in all the stubbornness of their heart, but shall be governed by the first

**2** regulations by which the men of the community were first instructed, until the coming of a prophet and the Messiahs of Aaron and Israel.

**3** These are the statutes for the Instructor to walk by them with every living being, according to the regulation of

**4** every time and the weight of every man: to do the will of God according to all

**5** that has been revealed for each time, and to acquire all the wisdom that has been found according to

**6** the times and the statute of the time. He shall separate and weigh the Sons of Righteousness according to their spirits,

**7** and hold fast to the chosen ones of the time according to his will, as he has commanded. Each man

**8** according to his spirit shall he judge; according to the cleanness of his hands shall he be admitted, and according to his understanding

**9** shall he be advanced — and likewise his love together with his hatred. He shall not reprove or dispute

**10** with the men of the pit, but shall conceal the counsel of the Torah among the men of injustice.

**11** He shall reprove with true knowledge and righteous judgment those who choose the way, each man according to his spirit,

**12** according to the regulation of the time, guiding them in knowledge and instructing them in the mysteries of

**13** wonder and truth, so that within the community they may walk perfectly, each with his neighbor,

**14** in all that has been revealed to them. This is the time for clearing the way

**15** to the wilderness. He shall instruct them in all that is required at this time, and to separate

**16** from every man who has not turned his way from all injustice.

**17** These are the regulations of the way for the Instructor in these times, for his loving and for his hating:

**18** eternal hatred for the men of the pit in a spirit of secrecy, leaving to them property and the labor of

**19** hands as a slave to his ruler, and humility before the one who has dominion over him.

**20** Each man shall be zealous for the statute and its time, for the day of vengeance. He shall perform

**21** the will of God in every undertaking of his hands and in all his dominion, as

**22** he has commanded. Everything that befalls him he shall accept willingly, and apart from the will of

**23** God nothing shall give him pleasure. He shall delight in all the words of his mouth and shall desire

**24** nothing that he has not commanded. He shall look continually to the judgment of God.

**25** In distress he shall bless his Maker, and in all that befalls him he shall recount

**26** his covenant-faithfulness, and amid the endurance of affliction he shall bless him. At all times he shall pray.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 9 opens with the famous messianic passage (line 2) referencing "a prophet and the Messiahs of Aaron and Israel" — a dual-messiah expectation. The Maskil (Instructor) section (lines 3-26) defines the spiritual guide's role: evaluating members, concealing wisdom from outsiders, and maintaining constant devotion. "Men of the pit" is a sectarian designation for those outside the covenant.*
